title: The town map's places: data/town_map/places.json
description: The table of places that the town map, the Pokédex's habitat map and a beacon's details read (TownMapData_GetParam), in order: a/0/8/5. tools/data/town_map_data.py packs it.

places.description: TOWNMAP_PLACE_COUNT places, in the order the code numbers them

zone.description: The zone the place stands for, which TownMapData_GetPlaceByZone finds it by

type.description: The kind of place, which picks its marker: 0 for the towns and cities, 1 the routes, 2 caves, forests and other landmarks, 3 the PWT, Pokéstar Studios, Join Avenue and Victory Road, 4 N's Castle, the Plasma Frigate and the Abyssal Ruins, 5 the Unity Tower

radius.description: How near the cursor must come to point at it, scaled by the zoom

cursor.description: Where the cursor points at it

hit.description: The capsule that a touch hits it in: a segment and its radius

fly.description: Whether the player can fly there once its arrival flag is set

unk13.description: Copied with the zone into the result of choosing it to fly to; 0 for every place

unk14.description: Copied with the zone into the result of choosing it to fly to; 0 for every place

arrival_flag.description: The event flag set when the player first arrives there, which lets them fly there; null for none

shown_by.description: The flag, an event flag or a TOWNMAP_FLAG_*, without which the place isn't on the map; null to show it always

description.description: Its description, a message of data/text/system/town_map.txt, or one per version where they differ

landmarks.description: The buildings and sights it lists, messages of data/text/system/town_map.txt

area.description: Its area on the Pokédex's habitat map: the animation that draws it and where
